Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood trial — timeline & next steps

Alex — great talking earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have everything captured from today's discovery: 

- Primary goal: evaluate Redwood inference for client-facing summarization pipelines (reduce latency for 1k-2k token responses, target p95 < 500ms).
- Success criteria: stable p95 under target across representative prompt set, <50% token cost of current solution, and no quality regression on the summary benchmark we discussed.

Proposed timeline & owners:
- May 10: Provision trial environment (Redwood) — owner: Sergio (I will kick off provisioning once you confirm).
- May 10–24: 2-week trial, Redwood will provide monitoring dashboard and token-cost breakdown.
- May 26: Short results review (30m) to determine next steps.

Action items for Fintegral: share the representative prompt set and a sample dataset (anonymized) by EOD May 4 so we can pre-seed KV cache and shape batching.

I've attached a short trial proposal and our SOC2 summary for procurement. Pricing for the 2-week trial is complimentary; if you move to a pilot we'll provide an estimate based on expected token volume.

Attachments: redwood-trial-proposal.pdf (proposal), SOC2-Audit-Summary.pdf (security overview)

If this looks right, reply with a quick yes on the May 10 start and drop the prompt set link and I'll get provisioning started.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
